body.statement:
For every \(I=(M,a,X,Y,c,L,B)\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{exp}}\), let \(C_X\) and \(C_Y\) be the weak components of \(X\) and \(Y\) in the underlying undirected full graph. If \(C_X\ne C_Y\), then \(X=a_X\) is not a Beckers actual cause of \(Y=a_Y\), the minimum witness cost is \(+\infty\), and \(C_X\) is a separating cut. Suppose instead that \(C_X=C_Y=C\) and that the connected graph \(G[C]\) has cycle rank at most one; no restriction is imposed on any other weak component. Every witness cost-nonincreasingly normalizes by retaining every edge and using the actual assignment outside \(C\), so existence and exact minimum cost equal those for the restricted instance \(I|_C\). If the rank is zero, the minimum is the value-path functional
\[
 \min_{s_i\in R(P_i)\setminus\{a_{P_i}\}}
 \sum_{i=1}^{m}C_i(s_{i-1},s_i),
\]
and the linear-arithmetic compiler and verifier apply. If the rank is one, the exceptional-edge modes and factor-graph recurrences specified by \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\) compute the exact minimum. Uniformly over both ranks, an algorithm uses \(O(L^7)\) arithmetic and indexed-address operations and polynomial bit time, every finite rational encountered has \(O(B+\log(L+1))\) bits, and it returns either a positive witness with an exact optimum certificate or a polynomial-size separating cut.
body.proof_tex:
Apply \(\texttt{lem:component-restriction-normalization}\). If \(C_X\ne C_Y\), that lemma proves noncausation. Moreover, no edge leaves the weak component \(C_X\), so \(C_X\) contains \(X\), excludes \(Y\), and is closed under every directed edge; it is a directly checkable separating cut. The causal minimum is therefore \(+\infty\).

Suppose \(C_X=C_Y=C\). The same lemma proves the equality
\[
 C^\star(I)=C^\star(I|_C) \tag{27}
\]
between the global causal minimum and the minimum on the relevant-component restriction, and it gives the asserted cost-nonincreasing normalization. Constructing \(C\) and \(I|_C\) takes a single scan of the explicit graph and tables; its encoding sizes \(L_C\) and \(B_C\) satisfy \(L_C\le L\) and \(B_C\le B\).

If \(G[C]\) has cycle rank zero, it is a tree because \(C\) is connected. Thus \(I|_C\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{forest}}\). By \(\texttt{thm:value-path-optimum}\), a witness exists exactly when the displayed value-path minimum is finite, and that minimum is \(C^\star(I|_C)\). The algorithms and three certificate types of \(\texttt{thm:compiler-verifier-equivalence}\) compute and verify this value using \(O(L_C)\) arithmetic and indexed-address operations with \(O(B_C+\log(L_C+1))\)-bit intermediates. Extending its positive certificate by the actual assignment and all edges outside \(C\), as in the component lemma, preserves the cost and truth of the decoded global claim. A negative path or reachability cut inside \(C\) remains separating in \(G\), because no edge joins distinct weak components.

If \(G[C]\) has cycle rank one, the restricted graph is connected and unicyclic, so \(\texttt{lem:connected-unicycle-min-sum}\) applies. It proves that the exceptional-edge min-sum functional equals \(C^\star(I|_C)\), computes it in \(O(L_C^7)\) operations with \(O(B_C+\log(L_C+1))\)-bit finite values, and supplies the stated positive, optimum, or separating certificate. Again the component lemma extends any positive certificate without cost and makes a component-level separating table a global one.

Combining each branch with (27), \(L_C\le L\), and \(B_C\le B\) proves all semantic, optimum, certificate, arithmetic, and bit-complexity assertions. Components outside \(C\) were never restricted; they are eliminated only by the proved normalization, not by redefining the causal target.
body.justification: The theorem identifies the largest proved positive class in this note by the query-relevant full component, preserves the exact optimum, and supplies auditable positive, optimality, and negative certificates even when irrelevant components have arbitrary cycle structure.
body.gap: Published Halpern--Pearl causal-tree propagation constrains the endogenous graph and does not establish the Beckers exceptional-edge reachability modes, actual-row hitting tests, or weak-component normalization used here.
body.consumer: An explicit-support backend for the \(\texttt{actualcauses}\) Python package can dispatch disconnected, forest, and unicycle relevant components and verify the returned witness, optimum, or separating cut.
